description: Base Renovate preset for every repository of the aimuzov account: weekly grouped updates, non-major ones merge themselves

packageRules.description: What ends up in production gets fix(deps): release-please cuts a release for it, while build(deps) waits for the next one
Base images of the containers end up in production too
A merge into main doesn't deploy, a release does, so non-major updates merge themselves once the checks pass. Renovate merges by itself, without the repo's auto-merge setting
